newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 11.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Summit of 11 regional owners of Air Afrique opens in Abidjan today to discuss rescue plan and appoint a new chief executive for troubled airline. A new takeoff?
- Air Afrique needs major capital injection
- Telephone monopoly CI-TELCOM has no more phone cards for public payphones after disappearance of 300,000 cards.
- Report by National Statistics Institute supports claim by opposition leader Laurent Gbagbo of poverty level of 75 percent in Ivory Coast.

- At meeting ahead of summit on Air Afrique, staff union denounces what it calls attempts to conclude deals detrimental to the company by its outgoing management; cites a planned alliance with Air France.
